```{r}
#| warning: false
# Loading required libraries
library(Hmisc)
library(mice)
library(ggplot2)

```

```{r}

# Reading the data
d1 <- sasxport.get("data/DEMO_I.xpt")
d2 <- sasxport.get("data/BPX_I.xpt")
d3 <- sasxport.get("data/BMX_I.xpt")
d4 <- sasxport.get("data/GHB_I.xpt")
d5 <- sasxport.get("data/TCHOL_I.xpt")

# Selecting a subset of the data
d1.t <- subset(d1, select = c("seqn", "riagendr", "ridageyr"))
d2.t <- subset(d2, select = c("seqn", "bpxsy1"))
d3.t <- subset(d3, select = c("seqn", "bmxbmi"))
d4.t <- subset(d4, select = c("seqn", "lbxgh"))
d5.t <- subset(d5, select = c("seqn", "lbdtcsi"))

# Merging the subsets
d <- merge(d1.t, d2.t)
d <- merge(d, d3.t)
d <- merge(d, d4.t)
d <- merge(d, d5.t)

```

```{r}

# Renaming the variables
d$age <- d$ridageyr   # age in years at screening
d$sex <- d$riagendr   # gender
d$bp <- d$bpxsy1      # systolic: blood pressure (1st rdg) mm Hg
d$bmi <- d$bmxbmi     # Body Mass Index (kg/m**2)
d$HbA1C <- d$lbxgh    # total cholesterol (mmol/L)
d$chol <- d$lbdtcsi   # Glycohemoglobin (%)

# Replacing every value in age that is below 18 with NA
d$age[d$age < 18] <- NA

# Selecting complete cases
dc <- cc(subset(d, select = c("age", "sex", "bmi", "HbA1C", "bp")))

# Saving the clean data
# save(dc, file = "data/clean_data.RData")

```

```{r}

# Analysis
model1 <- lm(bp ~ HbA1C + age + as.factor(sex), data = dc)
summary_model1 <- summary(model1)
# saveRDS(summary_model1, file = "analysis/summary_model1.rds")
ci_model1 <- confint(model1)
# saveRDS(ci_model1, file = "analysis/ci_model1.rds")

model2 <- lm(bp ~ HbA1C + bmi + age + as.factor(sex), data = dc)
summary_model2 <- summary(model2)
# saveRDS(summary_model2, file = "analysis/summary_model2.rds")
ci_model2 <- confint(model2)
# saveRDS(ci_model2, file = "analysis/ci_model2.rds")

```

```{r}

# Simulation of measurement error
# Calculating the reference regression coefficient 
ref <- lm(bp ~ HbA1C + bmi + age + as.factor(sex), data = dc)$coef[2]

# Defining simulation settings
n.sim <- 1e3
perc.me.exp <- seq(0, .5, .1)
perc.me.conf<- seq(0, .5, .1)

# Generating all possible combinations of measurement error percentages
scenarios <- expand.grid(perc.me.exp, perc.me.conf)

# Calculating the variances and sample size
var.exp <- var(dc$HbA1C)
var.conf <- var(dc$bmi)
n <- dim(dc)[1]

# Creating an empty matrix to store simulation results
beta.hat <- matrix(ncol = dim(scenarios)[1], nrow = n.sim)

# Running simulations across all scenarios
for (k in 1:n.sim) {
  print(k)
  set.seed(k)
  for (i in 1:dim(scenarios)[1]) {
    
    # measurement error variances
    var.me.exp <- var.exp * scenarios[i,1] / (1 - scenarios[i, 1])
    var.me.conf <- var.conf * scenarios[i, 2] / (1 - scenarios[i, 2])
    
    # introducing measurement error into exposure and confounder
    dc$HbA1C.me <- dc$HbA1C + rnorm(dim(dc)[1], 0, sqrt(var.me.exp) )
    dc$bmi.me <- dc$bmi + rnorm(dim(dc)[1], 0, sqrt(var.me.conf) )
    
    # estimating regression model and storing coefficient
    beta.hat[k,i] <- lm(bp ~ HbA1C.me + age + bmi.me + as.factor(sex), data = dc)$coef[2]
  }}
# saveRDS(beta.hat, file = "results/tables/beta_hat.rds")

# Creating figure
tot.mat <- cbind(100 * scenarios, apply(beta.hat, 2, mean))
colnames(tot.mat) <- c("me.exp", "me.conf", "estimate")

FIGURE <- ggplot(tot.mat, aes(me.exp, me.conf)) +
  geom_tile(color="white", aes(fill = estimate)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(estimate, 2))) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#D55E00", mid = "white", high = "#56B4E9", midpoint = ref) +
  labs(x = paste("% of total variance of HbA1c due to measurement error"),
       y = paste("% of total variance of BMI due to measurement error")) +
  coord_equal()+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = unique(tot.mat[, 1]))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(tot.mat[, 1]))+
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = 'white', colour = 'grey'),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))
FIGURE
# ggsave("results/figures/Figure_2.tif", FIGURE)

# Increasing HbA1c measurement error decreases the estimate, but increasing BMI measurement error actually increases it.

```
